{
    "ServerInstance": "SELECT @@SERVERNAME",
    "Database": "SELECT DB_NAME()",
    "siteId": "SELECT id FROM sites WHERE name = 'FDB (36)'",
    "userId": "SELECT * FROM users WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND LOWER(first_name) = LOWER('Mario') AND LOWER(last_name) = LOWER('Roy')",
    "patientId": "SELECT TOP (1) p.id FROM patients AS p JOIN external_ids AS e ON e.internal_id = p.id WHERE e.entity = 'patients' AND e.external_id = '1|20180823100701'",
    "initialCallCount": "update [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] set [weekly_usage_rolling_average] = -1 where user_id = <<userId>>;   set rowcount 100;   update [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] set [weekly_usage_rolling_average] = 1.0 where user_id = <<userId>>;   set rowcount 80;   update [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] set [weekly_usage_rolling_average] = 1.0 where user_id = <<userId>>;   set rowcount 60;   update [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] set [weekly_usage_rolling_average] = 1.0 where user_id = <<userId>>;   set rowcount 40;   update [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] set [weekly_usage_rolling_average] = 1.0 where user_id = <<userId>>;   set rowcount 20;   update [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] set [weekly_usage_rolling_average] = 1.0 where user_id = <<userId>>;   set rowcount 0;       SELECT  COUNT(*)   FROM  (SELECT  TOP(80) *       FROM  user_quick_list_items       WHERE  user_id = <<userId>>       AND  site_id = <<siteId>>       AND  weekly_usage_rolling_average > -1.0       ORDER BY  weekly_usage_rolling_average DESC) AS  t",
    "drugId_DI": "SELECT '{{uqlDrugId_DI}}'",
    "internalDrugId_HM": "SELECT '{{uqlInternalDrugId_HM}}'",
    "internalDrugName_HM": "SELECT '{{uqlInternalDrugName_HM}}'",
    "currentDt": "SELECT GETDATE()",
    "drugId_AR": "SELECT '{{uqlDrugId_AR}}'",
    "allergyDrugId_AR": "SELECT '{{uqlAllergyDrugId_AR}}'",
    "allergyClass_AR": "SELECT '{{uqlAllergyClass_AR}}'",
    "allergyCategory_AR": "SELECT '{{uqlAllergyCategory_AR}}'",
    "allergyName_AR": "SELECT '{{uqlAllergyName_AR}}'",
    
    "drugName_DI": "SELECT TOP (1) brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "drugDisplayName_DI": "SELECT TOP (1) long_brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "activeList_DI": "SELECT TOP (1) active FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "medicationId_DI": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_DI>>)   BEGIN     DECLARE @id_table TABLE(id INT);     INSERT INTO emar..medications     (site_id,drug_id,display_name,drug_vendor)     OUTPUT INSERTED.id INTO @id_table     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<drugId_DI>>,'<<drugDisplayName_DI>>','F');     INSERT INTO emar..medication_details     (medication_id,drug_id,brand_name,active_list,is_active)     VALUES   /**/     ((SELECT id FROM @id_table),<<drugId_DI>>,'<<drugName_DI>>','<<activeList_DI>>',1);   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "homeMedicationId": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_home_medications WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND internal_drug_id = '<<internalDrugId_HM>>')   BEGIN     INSERT INTO patient_home_medications     (patient_id,class,category,internal_drug_id,name,is_active,add_user_id,add_datetime,change_user_id,action_status)     VALUES     (<<patientId>>,0,0,'<<internalDrugId_HM>>','<<internalDrugName_HM>>',1,<<userId>>,'<<currentDt>>',0,'C')   END   /**/   SELECT * FROM patient_home_medications WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND internal_drug_id = '<<internalDrugId_HM>>'",
    "userQuicklistItemId_DI": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..user_quick_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND user_id = <<userId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_DI>>)   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..user_quick_list_items     (site_id,user_id,medication_id,dose,medication_unit_id,medication_route_id,frequency_schedule_id,order_notes,usages_this_week,weekly_usage_rolling_average,duration_in_minutes)     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<userId>>,<<medicationId_DI>>,NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,0,'-1.000',500)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..user_quick_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND user_id = <<userId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_DI>>",
    "drugName_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "drugDisplayName_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) long_brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "activeList_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) active FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "medicationId_AR": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_AR>>)   BEGIN     DECLARE @id_table TABLE(id INT);   /**/     INSERT INTO emar..medications     (site_id,drug_id,display_name,drug_vendor)     OUTPUT INSERTED.id INTO @id_table     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<drugId_AR>>,'<<drugDisplayName_AR>>','F');   /**/     INSERT INTO emar..medication_details     (medication_id,drug_id,brand_name,active_list,is_active)     VALUES     ((SELECT id FROM @id_table),<<drugId_AR>>,'<<drugName_AR>>','<<activeList_AR>>',1);   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "allergyId": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_allergies WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND (allergy_drug_id = '<<allergyDrugId_AR>>' OR class = <<allergyClass_AR>> OR category = <<allergyCategory_AR>>))   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..patient_allergies     (patient_id,class,category,name,allergy_drug_id,is_active,reaction,severity,add_user_id,add_datetime,change_user_id,action_status,information_source,medication_id)     VALUES     (<<patientId>>,0,0,'<<allergyName_AR>>','<<allergyDrugId_AR>>',1,'ALGRXNRASH','SEV1',<<userId>>,'<<currentDt>>',0,'C','PC',<<medicationId_AR>>)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_allergies WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND (allergy_drug_id = '<<allergyDrugId_AR>>' OR class = <<allergyClass_AR>> OR category = <<allergyCategory_AR>>)",
    "userQuicklistItemId_AR": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..user_quick_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND user_id = <<userId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_AR>>)   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..user_quick_list_items     (site_id,user_id,medication_id,dose,medication_unit_id,medication_route_id,frequency_schedule_id,order_notes,usages_this_week,weekly_usage_rolling_average,duration_in_minutes)     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<userId>>,<<medicationId_AR>>,NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,0,'-1.000',500)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..user_quick_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND user_id = <<userId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_AR>>",

    "Ignore_AttendingPhysician": "DECLARE  @physicianUserId int;   /**/   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP(1) * FROM user_patients WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND role_name = 'DOCTOR2')   BEGIN     SET @physicianUserId = (       SELECT  TOP (1) id       FROM  users       WHERE  is_active = 1       AND    site_id = <<siteId>>       AND    (type = 'D' OR ordering_only_physician = 1));   /**/     INSERT INTO user_patients     (user_id,patient_id,role_name)     VALUES     (@physicianUserId,<<patientId>>,'DOCTOR2');   END   /**/   SELECT TOP(1) * FROM user_patients WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND role_name = 'DOCTOR2';"    
}

    "medicationId_DI": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_DI>>)   BEGIN     DECLARE @id_table TABLE(id INT);     INSERT INTO emar..medications     (site_id,drug_id,display_name,drug_vendor)     OUTPUT INSERTED.id INTO @id_table     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<drugId_DI>>,'<<drugDisplayName_DI>>','F');     INSERT INTO emar..medication_details     (medication_id,drug_id,brand_name,active_list,is_active)     VALUES   /**/     ((SELECT id FROM @id_table),<<drugId_DI>>,'<<drugName_DI>>','<<activeList_DI>>',1);   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "homeMedicationId": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_home_medications WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND internal_drug_id = '<<internalDrugId_HM>>')   BEGIN     INSERT INTO patient_home_medications     (patient_id,class,category,internal_drug_id,name,is_active,add_user_id,add_datetime,change_user_id,action_status)     VALUES     (<<patientId>>,0,0,'<<internalDrugId_HM>>','<<internalDrugName_HM>>',1,<<userId>>,'<<currentDt>>',0,'C')   END   /**/   SELECT * FROM patient_home_medications WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND internal_drug_id = '<<internalDrugId_HM>>'",
    "departmentListItemId_DI": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..department_preferred_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_DI>>)   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..department_preferred_list_items     (site_id,department_code,dose,medication_unit_id,medication_route_id,frequency_schedule_id,order_notes,medication_id,duration_in_minutes)     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,'Main ED',NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,<<medicationId_DI>>,500)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..department_preferred_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_DI>>",
    "drugName_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "drugDisplayName_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) long_brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "activeList_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) active FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "medicationId_AR": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_AR>>)   BEGIN     DECLARE @id_table TABLE(id INT);   /**/     INSERT INTO emar..medications     (site_id,drug_id,display_name,drug_vendor)     OUTPUT INSERTED.id INTO @id_table     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<drugId_AR>>,'<<drugDisplayName_AR>>','F');   /**/     INSERT INTO emar..medication_details     (medication_id,drug_id,brand_name,active_list,is_active)     VALUES     ((SELECT id FROM @id_table),<<drugId_AR>>,'<<drugName_AR>>','<<activeList_AR>>',1);   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "allergyId": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_allergies WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND (allergy_drug_id = '<<allergyDrugId_AR>>' OR class = <<allergyClass_AR>> OR category = <<allergyCategory_AR>>))   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..patient_allergies     (patient_id,class,category,name,allergy_drug_id,is_active,reaction,severity,add_user_id,add_datetime,change_user_id,action_status,information_source,medication_id)     VALUES     (<<patientId>>,0,0,'<<allergyName_AR>>','<<allergyDrugId_AR>>',1,'ALGRXNRASH','SEV1',<<userId>>,'<<currentDt>>',0,'C','PC',<<medicationId_AR>>)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_allergies WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND (allergy_drug_id = '<<allergyDrugId_AR>>' OR class = <<allergyClass_AR>> OR category = <<allergyCategory_AR>>)",
    "DepartmentListItemId_AR": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..department_preferred_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_AR>>)   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..department_preferred_list_items     (site_id,department_code,dose,medication_unit_id,medication_route_id,frequency_schedule_id,order_notes,medication_id,duration_in_minutes)     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,'Main ED',NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,<<medicationId_AR>>,500)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..department_preferred_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_AR>>",

    "Ignore_AttendingPhysician": "DECLARE  @physicianUserId int;   /**/   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP(1) * FROM user_patients WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND role_name = 'DOCTOR2')   BEGIN     SET @physicianUserId = (       SELECT  TOP (1) id       FROM  users       WHERE  is_active = 1       AND    site_id = <<siteId>>       AND    (type = 'D' OR ordering_only_physician = 1));   /**/     INSERT INTO user_patients     (user_id,patient_id,role_name)     VALUES     (@physicianUserId,<<patientId>>,'DOCTOR2');   END   /**/   SELECT TOP(1) * FROM user_patients WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND role_name = 'DOCTOR2';"

{
    "ServerInstance": "SELECT @@SERVERNAME",
    "Database": "SELECT DB_NAME()",
    "siteId": "SELECT id FROM sites WHERE name = 'FDB (36)'",
    "userId": "SELECT * FROM users WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND LOWER(first_name) = LOWER('Mario') AND LOWER(last_name) = LOWER('Roy')",
    "patientId": "SELECT TOP (1) p.id FROM patients AS p JOIN external_ids AS e ON e.internal_id = p.id WHERE e.entity = 'patients' AND e.external_id = '1|20180823100701'",
    "drugId_DI": "SELECT '{{grlDrugId_DI}}'",
    "internalDrugId_HM": "SELECT '{{grlInternalDrugId_HM}}'",
    "internalDrugName_HM": "SELECT '{{grlInternalDrugName_HM}}'",
    "currentDt": "SELECT GETDATE()",
    "drugId_AR": "SELECT '{{grlDrugId_AR}}'",
    "allergyDrugId_AR": "SELECT '{{grlAllergyDrugId_AR}}'",
    "allergyClass_AR": "SELECT '{{grlAllergyClass_AR}}'",
    "allergyCategory_AR": "SELECT '{{grlAllergyCategory_AR}}'",
    "allergyName_AR": "SELECT '{{grlAllergyName_AR}}'",

    "drugName_DI": "SELECT TOP (1) brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "drugDisplayName_DI": "SELECT TOP (1) long_brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "activeList_DI": "SELECT TOP (1) active FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "medicationId_DI": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_DI>>)   BEGIN     DECLARE @id_table TABLE(id INT);     INSERT INTO emar..medications     (site_id,drug_id,display_name,drug_vendor)     OUTPUT INSERTED.id INTO @id_table     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<drugId_DI>>,'<<drugDisplayName_DI>>','F');     INSERT INTO emar..medication_details     (medication_id,drug_id,brand_name,active_list,is_active)     VALUES   /**/     ((SELECT id FROM @id_table),<<drugId_DI>>,'<<drugName_DI>>','<<activeList_DI>>',1);   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_DI>>",
    "homeMedicationId": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_home_medications WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND internal_drug_id = '<<internalDrugId_HM>>')   BEGIN     INSERT INTO patient_home_medications     (patient_id,class,category,internal_drug_id,name,is_active,add_user_id,add_datetime,change_user_id,action_status)     VALUES     (<<patientId>>,0,0,'<<internalDrugId_HM>>','<<internalDrugName_HM>>',1,<<userId>>,'<<currentDt>>',0,'C')   END   /**/   SELECT * FROM patient_home_medications WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND internal_drug_id = '<<internalDrugId_HM>>'",
    "groupListItem_DI": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..group_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_DI>>)   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..group_list_items     (site_id,department_code,group_name,dose,medication_unit_id,medication_route_id,frequency_schedule_id,order_notes,medication_id,duration_in_minutes)     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,'Main ED','Auto - meds',NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,<<medicationId_DI>>,500)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..group_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_DI>>",
    "drugName_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "drugDisplayName_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) long_brand_name FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "activeList_AR": "SELECT TOP (1) active FROM fdb_brand_name WHERE MEDID = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "medicationId_AR": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_AR>>)   BEGIN     DECLARE @id_table TABLE(id INT);   /**/     INSERT INTO emar..medications     (site_id,drug_id,display_name,drug_vendor)     OUTPUT INSERTED.id INTO @id_table     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,<<drugId_AR>>,'<<drugDisplayName_AR>>','F');   /**/     INSERT INTO emar..medication_details     (medication_id,drug_id,brand_name,active_list,is_active)     VALUES     ((SELECT id FROM @id_table),<<drugId_AR>>,'<<drugName_AR>>','<<activeList_AR>>',1);   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM medications AS m JOIN medication_details AS d ON d.medication_id = m.id WHERE m.site_id = <<siteId>> AND m.drug_vendor = 'F' AND d.drug_id = <<drugId_AR>>",
    "allergyId": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_allergies WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND (allergy_drug_id = '<<allergyDrugId_AR>>' OR class = <<allergyClass_AR>> OR category = <<allergyCategory_AR>>))   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..patient_allergies     (patient_id,class,category,name,allergy_drug_id,is_active,reaction,severity,add_user_id,add_datetime,change_user_id,action_status,information_source,medication_id)     VALUES     (<<patientId>>,0,0,'<<allergyName_AR>>','<<allergyDrugId_AR>>',1,'ALGRXNRASH','SEV1',<<userId>>,'<<currentDt>>',0,'C','PC',<<medicationId_AR>>)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..patient_allergies WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND (allergy_drug_id = '<<allergyDrugId_AR>>' OR class = <<allergyClass_AR>> OR category = <<allergyCategory_AR>>)",
    "groupListItem_AR": "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..group_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_AR>>)   BEGIN     INSERT INTO emar..group_list_items     (site_id,department_code,group_name,dose,medication_unit_id,medication_route_id,frequency_schedule_id,order_notes,medication_id,duration_in_minutes)     VALUES     (<<siteId>>,'Main ED','Auto - meds',NULL,NULL,NULL,1,NULL,<<medicationId_AR>>,500)   END   /**/   SELECT TOP (1) * FROM emar..group_list_items WHERE site_id = <<siteId>> AND medication_id = <<medicationId_AR>>",

    "Ignore_AttendingPhysician": "DECLARE  @physicianUserId int;   /**/   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP(1) * FROM user_patients WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND role_name = 'DOCTOR2')   BEGIN     SET @physicianUserId = (       SELECT  TOP (1) id       FROM  users       WHERE  is_active = 1       AND    site_id = <<siteId>>       AND    (type = 'D' OR ordering_only_physician = 1));   /**/     INSERT INTO user_patients     (user_id,patient_id,role_name)     VALUES     (@physicianUserId,<<patientId>>,'DOCTOR2');   END   /**/   SELECT TOP(1) * FROM user_patients WHERE patient_id = <<patientId>> AND role_name = 'DOCTOR2';"    
}

    "UserQuicklistItemId": "SELECT  TOP 1 l.id   FROM  user_quick_list_items AS l   JOIN  medication_details AS md ON l.medication_id = md.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_medication_doses AS pd ON l.medication_id = pd.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_medication_routes AS pr ON l.medication_id = pr.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_frequency_schedules AS pf ON l.medication_id = pf.medication_id   WHERE  md.brand_name = 'Acetaminophen Extra Strength' AND       l.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       l.user_id = <<UserId>> AND       pd.medication_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND       pd.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pr.medication_route_id IS NOT NULL AND       pr.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pf.frequency_schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND       pf.site_id = <<SiteId>>",
    "DepartmentPreferredListItemId": "SELECT  TOP 1 l.id   FROM  department_preferred_list_items AS l   JOIN  medication_details AS md ON l.medication_id = md.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_medication_doses AS pd ON l.medication_id = pd.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_medication_routes AS pr ON l.medication_id = pr.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_frequency_schedules AS pf ON l.medication_id = pf.medication_id   WHERE  md.brand_name = 'Acetaminophen Extra Strength' AND       l.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pd.medication_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND       pd.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pr.medication_route_id IS NOT NULL AND       pr.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pf.frequency_schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND       pf.site_id = <<SiteId>>",
    "GroupRememberedListItemId": "SELECT  TOP 1 l.id   FROM  group_list_items AS l   JOIN  medication_details AS md ON l.medication_id = md.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_medication_doses AS pd ON l.medication_id = pd.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_medication_routes AS pr ON l.medication_id = pr.medication_id   JOIN  preferred_frequency_schedules AS pf ON l.medication_id = pf.medication_id   WHERE  md.brand_name = 'Acetaminophen Extra Strength' AND       l.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pd.medication_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND       pd.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pr.medication_route_id IS NOT NULL AND       pr.site_id = <<SiteId>> AND       pf.frequency_schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND       pf.site_id = <<SiteId>>",

}

{
    "ServerInstance": "SELECT @@SERVERNAME",
    "Database": "SELECT DB_NAME()",
    "SiteId": "SELECT id FROM sites WHERE name = 'FDB (36)'",
    "Ignore_UpdateSiteSixteenFrequencies": "with FrequencyCount as ( select count(*) as [cnt] from [dbo].[frequency_schedules] where [frequency_schedules].[site_id] = 16 ) , FrequencyIndex as ( select row_number() over(order by [id]) - 1 as [idx], [frequency_schedules].[id] as [frequency_id] from [dbo].[frequency_schedules] where [frequency_schedules].[site_id] = 16 ) , ListIndex as ( select (row_number() over(order by [id]) - 1) % [FrequencyCount].[cnt] as [idx], [id] as [list_item_id] from [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] cross join [FrequencyCount] WHERE site_id = 16 ) update [d] set [frequency_schedule_id] = [f].[frequency_id] from   [dbo].[user_quick_list_items] [d] inner join [ListIndex] [l] on [d].[id] = [l].[list_item_id] inner join [FrequencyIndex] [f] on [l].[idx] = [f].[idx];",
    "cartOrderPatientId": "SELECT id FROM patients WHERE site_id = 16 and last_name  = 'Robertson' and first_name = 'Frank'",
	"scheduleId": "SELECT id FROM frequency_schedules WHERE REPLACE(notes, ' ', '') = '0000,0400,0800,1200,1600,2000' AND site_id = 16",
    "quickListUserId": "SELECT TOP 1 user_id FROM user_quick_list_items WHERE site_id = 16 GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC",
    "quickListItemId": "SELECT TOP 1 id FROM user_quick_list_items WHERE site_id = 16 and ISNULL(medication_unit_id, 0) > 0 and ISNULL(medication_route_id, 0) > 0 and user_id = <<quickListUserId>>",
    "quickListUserIdTabCount": "DECLARE @userId int = <<quickListUserId>>; WITH LetterList AS ( SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(SUBSTRING(m.display_name, 1, 1)) as tab FROM [user_quick_list_items] ql JOIN medications m ON ql.medication_id = m.id WHERE UPPER(SUBSTRING(m.display_name, 1, 1)) LIKE '[A-Z]' AND [user_id] = @userId ) , LetterCount AS (SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM LetterList) , NonLetterExists AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [user_quick_list_items] ql JOIN medications m ON ql.medication_id = m.id WHERE UPPER(SUBSTRING(m.display_name, 1, 1)) NOT LIKE '[A-Z]' AND [user_id] = @userId) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END As Exist ) SELECT lc.cnt + 1 + non.Exist FROM LetterCount lc CROSS JOIN NonLetterExists non; ",
    "Combo1": "DECLARE @user_id int = (     SELECT  TOP 1 user_id     FROM  user_quick_list_items ql     JOIN  medications m         ON ql.medication_id = m.id     WHERE  ql.site_id = <<SiteId>>     AND    UPPER(m.display_name) NOT LIKE '[A-Z]%'     GROUP BY user_id, ql.site_id   )   /**/   IF @user_id IS NULL   BEGIN     /* Copy a # order from another site, to a different user on this site */     SELECT  @user_id = (       SELECT  TOP 1 user_id       FROM  user_quick_list_items       WHERE  site_id = <<SiteId>>       AND    user_id != <<quickListUserId>>       ORDER BY 1 DESC     )   /**/     INSERT  user_quick_list_items         (site_id, user_id, dose, medication_unit_id, medication_route_id, frequency_schedule_id, order_notes, usages_this_week,          weekly_usage_rolling_average, medication_id, duration_in_minutes)     SELECT  TOP 1 <<SiteId>>, @user_id, dose, medication_unit_id, medication_route_id, frequency_schedule_id, order_notes, usages_this_week,          weekly_usage_rolling_average, medication_id, duration_in_minutes     FROM  user_quick_list_items ql     JOIN  medications m         ON ql.medication_id = m.id     WHERE  UPPER(m.display_name) NOT LIKE '[A-Z]%';   END   /**/   DECLARE @FirstTab char(1) = (     SELECT  TOP 1 CASE WHEN UPPER(m.display_name) LIKE '[A-Z]%'  THEN UPPER(SUBSTRING(m.display_name, 1, 1)) ELSE '#' END     FROM  user_quick_list_items ql     JOIN  medications m         ON ql.medication_id = m.id     WHERE  user_id = @user_id     and    ql.site_id = <<SiteId>>     ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(m.display_name) LIKE '[A-Z]%'  THEN UPPER(m.display_name) ELSE 'ZZZZZ' END   );   /**/   DECLARE @PoundTabOrderCount int = (SELECT COUNT(*)     FROM user_quick_list_items ql     JOIN medications m         ON ql.medication_id = m.id     WHERE user_id = @user_id     and ql.site_id = <<SiteId>>     AND m.display_name NOT LIKE '[A-Za-z]%');   /**/   DECLARE @FirstTabCount int   IF @FirstTab = '#'     SET @FirstTabCount = @PoundTabOrderCount   ELSE     SELECT @FirstTabCount = COUNT(*)     FROM user_quick_list_items ql     JOIN medications m         ON ql.medication_id = m.id     WHERE user_id = @user_id     and ql.site_id = <<SiteId>>     AND UPPER(m.display_name) LIKE @FirstTab + '%';   /**/   DECLARE @TabCount int;   WITH AlphaTabs AS (     SELECT  UPPER(SUBSTRING(m.display_name, 1, 1)) as tabname     FROM user_quick_list_items ql     JOIN medications m         ON ql.medication_id = m.id     WHERE user_id = @user_id     and ql.site_id = <<SiteId>>     AND m.display_name LIKE '[A-Za-z]%'     GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTRING(m.display_name, 1, 1))   )   SELECT @TabCount = 1 + COUNT(*) FROM AlphaTabs;
